items.title: 68359_Zutty Singleton oral history interview
items.q: he took us down to Miss Cotton's where the 'House of Meditation' was and had her to give us a room.

ctx.x: And we went up to see old Brud (Breaud). And then old woman Brud found us a place to stay. Right in the place I was telling you about the 'House of Meditation'. Like with Miss Cotton. Yes, old Brud (Breaud) fixed us up. Because I did but have fifty cents when I came out of the Harlem Tunnel.
